name: com.gameframex.unity.tuyoogame.yooasset.tiktok
description:
GameFrameX YooAsset TikTok — international TikTok mini-game FileSystem adapter skeleton for Unity WebGL. Placeholder package reserving the runtime surface for the international TikTok SDK integration; it currently ships only a CroppingHelper stub, and the IWebPlayModeFileSystemProvider and IFileSystem implementation will be added once the international TikTok SDK is finalized. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX YooAsset TikTok — 国际版 TikTok 小游戏 FileSystem 适配骨架功能包。为国际版 TikTok SDK 接入预留运行时空位，当前仅包含 CroppingHelper 占位类，IWebPlayModeFileSystemProvider 与 IFileSystem 实现待国际版 SDK 确定后补齐。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
